notes:
Summary: inbound lead from sales enablement app vendor. Customer goal: replace incumbent transcription+summary pipeline (Otter/Gong) with hosted Redwood API to reduce cost and get better control over retention/PII.

Key contacts: Emma Ruiz (Head of Product), Raj Patel (CTO)

Activity timeline:
- 2026-02-10: inbound via email thread gm-20260210-1298 (Emma). Interested in self-serve hosted API; asked about SOC2 + retention options.
- 2026-02-12: AE intro (Avery Chen) — quick discovery call. Volume estimate: 30-80k generated tokens/month; spikes from demos ~1M tokens/mo in campaigns. Primary workload: async call summaries + short coaching snippets. Latency target: streaming responses ok; not ultra-low but want <500ms for chunked streaming.
- 2026-02-15: Provided security FAQ (drive link). Emma ran a short smoke test with free credits — created account, ran sample prompts (transcription -> summary pipeline). Shared initial eval: summaries are high quality but sensitive fields (phone numbers, SSNs) sometimes retained.
- 2026-03-01: Requested follow-up around PII removal options and retention windows. Questions: "Can Redwood redact or mask PII at ingestion?", "Is there a delete-by-customer API and event log?". Also asked about default retention for Hosted API and whether we persist raw transcripts.
- 2026-03-05: SE call (Marcus Delgado). Demonstrated token billing and streaming. Discussed our prefix-caching and how KV cache does/doesn't store transcripts. Confirmed hosted API does not expose customer transcripts to humans; we need to confirm retention default and whether logs can be shortened to 7 days for SMB customers. Emma: "We can't store raw transcripts longer than 14 days due to customer contracts."

Use-case & requirements:
- Workload: call summary + CRM enrichment; post-call summary generation and tag extraction for HubSpot.
- Privacy: Must support SSO + SCIM for employees; require SOC2 or equivalent attestation; audit logs for deletions.
- Retention: prefer configurable retention per tenant (7-30 days); ability to issue delete requests (API) and confirmation event.
- PII handling: redaction or on-device preprocessing preferred. They asked about client-side PII hashing/obfuscation guidance.
- Integrations: HubSpot + AWS S3 export for attachments.

POC / Eval plan:
- Self-serve trial already started using free credits.
- Acceptance criteria: summaries >=85% accuracy on labeled prompt set; deletion API works; retention policy adjustable to 7 days.
- Technical POC owners: Raj Patel (CTO) and Dev lead Maria Lopez.

Pricing sensitivity: SMB self-serve budget tight. Looking for clear per-token pricing + predictable monthly cap. Interested in committing to reserved capacity only if ARR > $30k.

Next steps:
- (AE) Send hosted API pricing + retention FAQ + retention SLA language (Avery) — DONE draft to send 2026-03-06.
- (SE) Share short doc on client-side PII obfuscation patterns and sample code (Marcus) — in progress.
- Schedule 30-min demo focused on retention controls and delete API for week of 2026-03-16.

Open blockers: need written confirmation about default retention period for Hosted API and documented delete API/confirmation flow. Also want sample HubSpot integration flow for summary -> contact notes.

Notes: tone is pragmatic, budget-conscious. Strong potential for self-serve conversion if retention answers are satisfactory. Emma likely to advocate internally if legal sign-off satisfied.
